metadata.description: Agent workflow plugins from Hannah Vernon. Works in both GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code.

plugins.name: agent-session-checkpoints
plugins.description: Write and restore session checkpoints so work survives the end of a coding session. Covers what a checkpoint must contain, how to restore one at the start of the next session, how to log changes that git diff cannot see, and the failure modes that make a checkpoint useless when you come back to it.
